newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kesko sees full-yr profit over FIM 650 mln.
newsitem.headline: Kesko sees full-yr profit over FIM 650 mln.

text.p: Finnish wholesaler and retailer Kesko Oy said on Wednesday it expected full-year 1997 profit before extraordinary items and tax to exceed 650 million markka compared with a 1996 profit of 740 million markka.
"It is estimated that the group's profit before extraordinary items and taxes will exceed 650 million markka," Kesko said in a statement with its Janaury-April results.
Group net sales would "develop slightly faster than the total market", it said. In 1996, net sales were 29.3 billion markka.
"Expectations are highest in the shoe, clothing and sports goods trade, as well as in machinery and builders' supplies," Kesko said.
It said the outlook for the expansion of the newly acquired Carrols hamburger restaurant chain was good. @
